verdict.rationale: LibreChat's core is built-in AI assistants. Its Agents feature lets users build custom assistants in the Agent Builder side panel and invoke them in chat with an "@" mention. Those agents can handle files, run code, call API actions and use MCP tools, and docs also cover subagents and scheduled chats for delegating work. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents completing delegated tasks (the community item covers plugins/functions only generally), and the subagent and scheduled-chat delegation docs appear only as page titles.
